capability-ledger-updated.ref: Deliberately not updated: server/services/chatTools.ts only changes the get_price_estimate PRICE_MAP values for diagnostic, check engine and tire to read DIAGNOSTIC_PRICE.fee ($49, waived with the repair) and BUSINESS.newTires.startingDollars ($89), the operator's 2026-10-01 prices from #2868. No capability is added, removed, wired or unwired, and no state changes. Proof: server/services/chatTools-honesty.test.ts runs the tool and asserts lowEstimate/highEstimate/note for 'diagnostic', 'check engine light' and 'new tires' (red 75 and 80 before the fix, green after).
